question: A motorcycle costs Tk. 2500 when it is brand new. At the end of each year it is worth 4/5 of what it was at the beginning of the year. What is the motorcycle worth when it is 3 years old?
explanation:
🔖At the end of first year, the motorcycle is worth = 4/5 of 2500 = 2000 TK
At the end of second year, the motorcycle is worth = 4/5 of 2000 = 1600 TK
At the end of third year, the motorcycle is worth = 4/5 of 1600 = 1280 TK
[Shortcut = 4/5 x 4/5 x 4/5 x 2500]
subject: গাণিতিক যুক্তি

question: If X and Y are prime numbers, then which of the following cannot be the the sum of X and Y?
explanation:
🔖Here, the highest total is 23.
Now, Prime numbers upto 23 = 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23.
Here, 2+3=5; 2+11=13; 5+11=16;
But, no pair of numbers from these numbers adds up to 23.

question: If Tk. 4,500 was invested in a share when the price per share was Tk. 9 and Tk. 3,000 was invested in another share when the price per share was Tk. 10. What was the average price per share purchased?
explanation:
🔖When tk 9, number of share = 4500/9 = 500
When tk 10, number of share = 3000/10 = 300
Average price = Total price of share / Total number of share = (4500+3000) / (500+300) = 7500/800 = 9.375

question: It costs X taka each to make the first thousand copies of a CD and Y taka to make each subsequent copy. How many taka will it cost to make Z copies (Z is greater than 1000) of the CD?
explanation:
🔖For first thousand copies = 1000X tk
As, Z is greater than 1000, we have to substract 1000Y from 1000X.
And for extra copies, the cost = YZ
So, the equation = (1000X - 1000Y) + YZ = 1000(X-Y) + YZ
